rationale: EO 10513 (19 FR 369) designated the Assistant Secretaries and the Solicitor of Labor to act as Secretary of Labor when both the Secretary and the Under Secretary were unavailable, and superseded EO 9968. Section 4 of EO 13245 (66 FR 66268, signed 2001-12-18) states that Executive Order 10513 of January 19, 1954, is hereby revoked, and 13245 prescribes a new succession order. The revocation is express, whole-order and unqualified, and no earlier ending or revival was found in the held texts that cite the order. The order therefore had no force on 2026-10-14. Recommended status: no.
